report.summary: Audited frozen range bd27b742→57e954fe (23 files, matching frozen changed_paths) against the frozen Build B plan. B1 convertible-note extraction, B2 uncommenced-lease commitments, and B3 cash-plus-current-marketable-securities are implemented as deterministic, fail-closed, source-bound extractors: single-vintage primary selection (issuer/accession/URL/primary-doc/hash pinned), explicit unit/currency locators, maturity-before-as_of rejection (Review Focus 3), conversion-price conflict/cross-note (2030) bleed suppression, rounding-interval lease dedup at displayed MD&A precision, and balance-sheet-presentation-gated current classification with alias/ambiguity/vintage fail-closed paths. The 844,741,000 USD calculation is labeled statement liquidity with cited input fact IDs, the EV bridge provably keeps cash-only (substitution test), and vendor exception text never reaches prompts/state. Delivery occurs in SourceAcquisition before analyst fan-out; render replays against the pinned corpus and hard-fails on issuer/cutoff/hash/record tamper (all four tested); records persist through state log, evidence.json and report appendix; the shared_source_brief=4 signature bump separates predecessor checkpoint identity. Test coverage matches every named required test plus substantial extra adversarial cases. Acceptance/runtime receipts are internally consistent (same corpus hash 24d12b34…, 12 prompt receipts containing the required phrases, zero network/paid calls, locator-removal independence drill) and honestly disclose the first-attempt canonical source-ID collision fix and the Build2 fixture signature patch. No in-scope Critical/High/Medium gaps found; five Low observations documented. This audit grants no integration or release authority.
limitations: Read-only audit of the frozen manifest only: tests, ruff, the DOCN proof script and the full suite were not re-executed; the reported 3236 passed/10 skipped result, prompt receipts and runtime JSONs are builder-run evidence verified only for internal consistency.

The frozen evidence contains only the diff and the governing plan text; unchanged HEAD files referenced by the change (document_access.py, evidence_presentation.py, filing_search.py, sec_documents.py, financial_evidence.py, _facts/_same/_money helpers, canonical-context renderer, CI workflow, audit skill templates) were not available, so behaviors they own (e.g., prepare_document_sources idempotency on the second call, _same/_money period/unit checks, C-row label rendering) are inferred from tests and receipts rather than inspected.

The test fixture tests/fixtures/docn_2026q3/live02_filing_package.json used by the B3 presentation-gate tests is not in the frozen diff, so the exact balance-sheet block serialization the _displayed_current_balance regex depends on could not be inspected.
Private proof inputs (saved November 7 DOCN state, cached SEC bytes, raw prompts) are by design not audit inputs; only sanitized hashes/receipts were checked.
Base-commit context for modified hunks was limited to diff context lines; surrounding unchanged logic in evidence_validation.py, context.py, sec_edgar.py and trading_graph.py was not fully visible.

findings.title: Liquidity check does not require instant (period_start is None) securities input; relies on the upstream classifier being the only producer of 'Current Marketable Securities'
_PRICE tempered 350-char window blocks '. <Uppercase>' and other note-series mentions but could cross a lowercase sentence continuation, a residual (untested) cross-sentence price-bleed path

Current-securities presentation gate hardcodes the '(unaudited)' and '(in thousands, except share amounts)' heading triple, so 10-K or other legitimate layouts can never classify (fail-closed narrowness beyond the stated DOCN 10-Q target; not documented as a general limitation in code)

Historical Build2 continuation fixture now monkeypatches production TradingAgentsGraph._run_signature back to shared_source_brief=3, slightly weakening that regression; mitigated by the separate identity-separation test and documented in the acceptance record
Rendered instrument line deviates cosmetically from the plan template ('approximately' vs '≈', '312322' vs '312,322' thousands separator); semantics and all plan-specified assertions are preserved

_displayed_current_balance anchors labels with (?:^|;) without re.MULTILINE, so recognition depends on the ';'-delimited block serialization; mismatch fails closed (no false classification) but silently blocks classification for newline-serialized tables

escalation_reasons: Frozen scope changes more than 10 files or more than 500 lines.
